overviewTitle: Amazon Account Management Services That Keep Your Store Running
intro: Amazon sellers rarely get stuck because of the product. It’s usually the daily work around it: listings that need fixing, ad budgets that need watching, stock that needs ordering, and policy emails that need a reply the same day. Alpha Digital Solutions provides Amazon account management services that take over that workload, so you can concentrate on sourcing and your brand.
Whether you want a single area covered or Amazon full account management from listings to reporting, we customise  our support to fit your daily operations.
Not sure where your account is losing sales? Book a free consultation and we’ll look at it together.

sections.title: What Our Amazon Account Management Service Covers
sections.intro: Our Amazon seller account management service covers the daily running of your Seller Central account. Your account manager looks after the following.

items.title: Listing Setup and Optimisation
items.text: Titles, bullet points, descriptions and backend search terms are rewritten around what shoppers type into Amazon, and kept within each category’s rules

items.title: A+ Content and Brand Stores
items.text: For brands enrolled in Brand Registry, we plan and build enhanced content and storefront pages that give buyers more to go on before they add to cart.

items.title: Amazon PPC Management
items.text: We run Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns, clean up wasted search terms and move budget to the keywords that actually sell.

items.title: Inventory and FBA Planning
items.text: We track sell-through and restock dates so you avoid stock-outs and excess storage. This works for FBA, FBM or a mix of both.

items.title: Pricing and Promotions
items.text: Coupons, deals and Subscribe & Save are used only where your margin allows it.

items.title: Account Health Monitoring
items.text: We check your Account Health dashboard, deal with listing violations and prepare plans of action if Amazon suspends a listing or account.

items.title: Brand Protection
items.text: We help register your trademark in Brand Registry and report hijackers and copycat listings.

items.title: Reviews and Feedback
items.text: We use only Amazon-approved methods, such as the Request a Review button and Vine where your product qualifies. We also fix the product or listing problems behind poor ratings.

items.title: Reporting
items.text: You get regular sales, ad and margin reports with notes on what we plan to do next.

sections.outro: Everything above is part of Amazon seller account management, and the scope for your store is agreed with you before work starts.

sections.title: Amazon Account Management Services for New and Established Sellers

items.title: New Amazon Sellers

items.title: Established Brands
items.text: Listing audits, ad restructuring and ongoing optimisation of what is already live.

items.title: Private Label and Wholesale Sellers
items.text: Buy Box monitoring, pricing control, restock planning and protection against other sellers on your listings.

items.title: Sellers on Several Marketplaces
items.text: Support across the Amazon stores you sell in, depending on your setup.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About Amazon Account Management Services

faqs.question: What is Amazon account management?
faqs.answer: It means handing the daily running of your Amazon seller account to a specialist or team. That covers listings, advertising, inventory, account health and reporting. It suits sellers who want growth without spending every day inside Seller Central.

faqs.question: What does your Amazon full account management include?
faqs.answer: Full account management covers every area above in one engagement: listing work, PPC, inventory planning, brand tools, health monitoring and reporting, with a single point of contact. If you only need one or two parts, such as ads or listings, we can scope it that way.

faqs.question: How much do Amazon account management services cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on your catalogue size, ad spend and the services you choose. Agencies generally charge a monthly retainer, a percentage of sales, or a mix of the two. After a look at your account on the first call, we give you a fixed quote.

faqs.question: Can you help if my Amazon account is suspended?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send us the notice and we’ll review what triggered it. We’ll tell you plainly whether an appeal looks winnable before you commit to anything.

faqs.question: Do I lose control of my account if I hire an agency?
faqs.answer: No. You remain the account owner, and we only get the user access you grant.

faqs.question: Is it worth hiring someone to manage my Amazon account?
faqs.answer: It can be, particularly if the account takes more time than you have or your ads and listings aren’t performing. The free consultation with us is the quickest way to find out, and we’ll tell you honestly if it isn’t worth it for your store yet.
